body.name: bOVS
body.def: For each target block \(k\), let \(K_k=\begin{psmallmatrix}\Omega_{kk}&\mathbf 1\\\mathbf 1^{\prime}&0\end{psmallmatrix}\) and define \(\binom{b^{\mathrm{OVS}}_k}{\lambda_k}=K_k^{\dagger}\binom{0}{\omega_k}\). The Moore--Penrose solution is the minimum-Euclidean-norm member of the blockwise quadratic-program solution set; this convention remains defined when \(\Omega_{kk}\) is singular and reduces to \(\omega_k\Omega_{kk}^{-1}\mathbf 1/(\mathbf 1^{\prime}\Omega_{kk}^{-1}\mathbf 1)\) when \(\Omega_{kk}\) is nonsingular. The blocks are stacked in \(\mathcal I\)-order.
